summary.text: Kanika Brown is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 71 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists her occupation as healthcare habilitation worker and her county as Forsyth.

paragraphs.text: Brown assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Evelyn Terry.
She is in her second House term, according to the General Assembly's website.

In the 2025-2026 session she is a member of the Agriculture and Environment, Alcoholic Beverage Control, Appropriations, Appropriations, General Government, and Commerce and Economic Development committees.
